What I build

Two products. One engineer. End-to-end delivery.

I don't hand you a notebook. I ship a deployed, monitored, evaluated system your team can actually use — then train your engineers to maintain it.

Custom RAG Systems
Answers from your documents — with citations, not hallucinations.

End-to-end retrieval-augmented generation pipelines that ground LLM answers in your private documents. Built with chunking strategies tuned to your content type, hybrid retrieval (keyword + semantic), reranking, and answer-verification layers so users get accurate, source-cited responses every time.

  • Document ingestion: PDFs, Notion, Confluence, Slack, Google Drive
  • Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense embeddings (OpenAI, Cohere, or local)
  • Reranking with cross-encoders for precision
  • Citations and source previews in every answer
  • Eval suites: faithfulness, relevance, citation accuracy
  • Streaming responses for sub-2s perceived latency
Stack
LangChain / LlamaIndexPinecone / Qdrant / pgvectorOpenAI / Anthropic / Local LLMs
See it live
Natural-Language SQL Agents
Let anyone on your team ask questions in English. Get SQL back.

Conversational agents that translate business questions into validated SQL against your existing databases. Schema-aware prompt construction, query validation, read-only execution safety, and natural-language summaries of the results — so non-technical stakeholders self-serve analytics without breaking anything.

  • Schema introspection and dynamic prompt construction
  • Read-only DB user + query validation for safety
  • Multi-turn conversations with context (filters, follow-ups)
  • Auto-generated visualizations (charts, tables)
  • Natural-language summaries of every result set
  • Works with Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
Stack
LangGraph / custom orchestrationVanna / RAGAS for SQLAny JDBC-compatible DB

Where I've shipped

Built for knowledge-intensive industries

The same RAG + SQL primitives, tuned to each industry's accuracy, compliance, and latency requirements.

Legal

Case-law GraphRAG for due diligence — retrieve precedents, statutes, and rulings with citations partners can trust.

"Find every ruling in CA on non-compete clauses from 2020+"

Financial Services

Research assistants that synthesize filings, transcripts, and internal memos. SQL agents for portfolio analytics.

"Summarize the risk factors from this 10-K with citations"

Healthcare

Clinical knowledge bases grounded in SOPs, formularies, and guidelines — with strict source attribution and audit logs.

"What's the protocol for adult sepsis at our hospital?"

E-commerce Ops

SQL agents for inventory, fulfillment, and LTV analytics — letting ops teams self-serve without pinging data.

"Which SKUs have <10 units left and >50 weekly sales?"

Manufacturing

Maintenance manuals + IoT logs in one RAG. Technicians ask in plain language, get the right page + safety warnings.

"Why is line 3 showing error code E-447?"

Education

Course-material tutors that answer student questions strictly from the syllabus — no made-up citations, ever.

"Explain the difference between TCP and UDP from week 4"

Travel & Hospitality

Policy + booking agents that handle complex multi-step questions across reservation, loyalty, and fare-rule systems.

"Can I rebook a cancelled flight to a partner airline?"

Internal IT / DevOps

Runbooks, postmortems, and Confluence in one RAG. On-call engineers resolve incidents faster with cited answers.

"What's the rollback procedure for the payments service?"

How we'll work

From zero to deployed in 6 weeks

Transparent milestones. Weekly demos. Code in your repo. You see the system working before any large commitment.

01

Discovery (Week 1)

We map your data sources, success criteria, latency budget, and compliance constraints. You get a written architecture proposal with eval criteria — before any code is written.

  • Architecture doc
  • Eval rubric
  • Fixed-quote proposal
02

Prototype (Week 1–2)

A working slice of the system on a real subset of your data — chunking strategy, retrieval, answer generation, eval scores. You see it work before committing to full build.

  • Live prototype URL
  • Baseline eval report
  • Refined scope
03

Build (Week 2–4)

Full implementation: ingestion pipelines, vector store, retrieval + reranking, query layer, observability. Weekly demos. Code lives in your repo from day one.

  • Production code
  • CI/CD
  • Eval suite (automated)
04

Eval & Hardening (Week 4–5)

Adversarial testing, hallucination checks, latency tuning, security review. We hit your success metrics before launch — not after.

  • Eval report (passing)
  • Latency benchmarks
  • Security checklist
05

Deploy (Week 5–6)

Deployed to your cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure / on-prem) with monitoring, alerting, and rollback. Documentation and a 1-hour handoff session for your team.

  • Live deployment
  • Runbook
  • Team handoff session
06

Iterate (Ongoing)

Optional retainer: weekly eval runs, drift detection, model upgrades, and feature additions. Or I train your team to own it — your call.

  • Weekly eval reports
  • On-call support
  • Training sessions
